facts.statement: Angustinaripterus was a basal pterosaur belonging to the family Rhamphorhynchidae and was discovered in Dashanpu near Zigong in Sichuan province, China.
facts.quote: Angustinaripterus was a basal pterosaur, belonging to the breviquartossan family Rhamphorhynchidae (more specifically within the subfamily Rhamphorhynchinae) and discovered at Dashanpu near Zigong in the Sichuan province of China.

facts.statement: The genus Angustinaripterus was named in 1983 by He Xinlu, Yang Daihuan, and Su Chunkang.
facts.quote: Angustinaripterus was named in 1983 by He Xinlu, Yang Daihuan, and Su Chunkang.

facts.statement: The skull of Angustinaripterus is very elongated and flat.
facts.quote: The skull of Angustinaripterus, of which the left side is severely damaged, is very elongated and flat.

facts.statement: The mandible contains at least ten pairs of teeth, possibly twelve.
facts.quote: In the mandible there are at least ten pairs of teeth, perhaps twelve.

facts.statement: He et al. (1983) classified Angustinaripterus within the family Rhamphorhynchidae.
facts.quote: He et al. (1983) placed Angustinaripterus into the family Rhamphorhynchidae.

facts.statement: Angustinaripterus lived from the Bajocian to the Oxfordian, between 170.9 and 154.8 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Bajocian to Oxfordian (170.9 to 154.8 million years ago)

facts.statement: The genus name is derived from the Latin words for 'narrow' and 'nostril' combined with the Greek word for 'wing'.
facts.quote: El nombre del género se deriva del latín angustus, "estrecho" y naris, "narina", combinado con el griego latinizado pteron, "ala".

facts.statement: The species name is derived from the Latin word for 'long' and the Greek word for 'head'.
facts.quote: El nombre de la especie se deriva del latín longus, "largo", y el griego kephale, "cabeza".

facts.statement: The preserved skull measures 192 mm in length, with an estimated total length of 201 mm if complete.
facts.quote: En su actual estado tiene una longitud de 192 milímetros; la longitud total si estuviera completa se estima en 201 milímetros.

facts.statement: The front teeth formed an intermeshed trap that may have been used to catch fish from the water surface.
facts.quote: En el frente ellos forman una especie de trampa entrelazada, que puede haber sido usada para atrapar peces de la superficie del agua.

facts.statement: David Unwin considers Angustinaripterus to be a member of the subfamily Rhamphorhynchinae rather than Scaphognathinae.
facts.quote: David Unwin sin embargo, lo considera un miembro de otro subgrupo de ramforrínquidos: los Rhamphorhynchinae.
